item.tib: khams brgyad gtan la phab pa bka' rnam par nges pa las dum bu 'og ma
item.coloph: bka' rnam par nges pa 'di nyid / mi yi dbang po khro chen rgyal po kun dga' nor bus legs tshogs mi mdzad pa[r] du bskrus [~bskrun] pa'i tshe / khro chen nang so rin po ches zhus dag legs par mdzad cing / rjes sor yang lan gnyis yang sogs zhus dag par bgyis shing / spar byang nyung du tshigs su bcad pa phran smon rgyal sad sa rin gyis shing sprel zla tshes bzang po la …
item.note: the colophon informs us that the text was revealed by sgom-chen gshen-sgur at co-ro 'bri-mtshams mtha'-dkar, and then passed on to zhu-yas legs-po. the woodblock printing was patronized by the khro-chen king kun-dga' nor-bu. the colophon verses were composed in Wood monkey year (shing sprel) by one smon-rgyal sad-sa-rin. it is likely that smon-rgyal sad-sa-rin would be a name of kun-grol grags-pa. in this case, the Wood monkey year would be 1764. p. 363 (281) is physically missing. the nos. 7 and 86 are used twice, but the contents of the fols. are not the same. there is no 250, but the text continues without break. the present manuscript was evidently copied directly from the khro-chen xylographic edition.
